content.text:
The app now matches the sidebar and panel spec from the last change. It builds with no warnings, all 244 tests pass, and clippy is clean on the files I changed. I didn't add a test for the new header colour or the line between panels, and I haven't looked at them in the running app.

- **Shared panel look (new `src/sidebar.rs`):**
  - A panel header now sits on the theme's raised surface, with an optional muted count at its right. The panel body stays on the base surface, with no line between header and body.
  - Panels are separated by a single one-pixel line in the theme's line colour.
- **Referenced spec sidebar (`src/referenced_spec.rs`):** the "Referenced spec" and "Understanding" headers now use that shared header. Before, they were drawn on the same colour as the body; now they stand slightly apart from it.
- **Body sidebar (`src/main_window.rs`, `src/git_panel.rs`):**
  - The git panel no longer draws its own top border. The sidebar draws the line between the file tree and the git panel, and only while the git panel shows (inside a git repository).
  - `GitPanel` has a new `is_shown()` so the sidebar can tell.
  - What you'll see is much the same line as before, now in the line colour rather than the border colour.

Some things in the spec needed no code changes:
- The draggable edge lines, on the body sidebar and between the two referenced spec panels, were already drawn by gpui-kit.
- The widths (260 to start, 160 at the narrowest), the 80-pixel minimum for each shared panel, and the understanding rows fading back to the body were already right.

The Belay shape reference has only the Chat Input instruction, so nothing there changed how the code is laid out.

I wrote this task's constraints to `.suspense/history/1789719009-Prompt_ecffbaf134026613.understanding.md`. Nothing is committed.

The Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors still need authorizing in your claude.ai connector settings before they can be used.
